senses.gloss:
ITA-4.6.11 vyaktiḥ व्यक्तिः
Stage of clinical manifestation of a disease
The fifth stage of disease manifestation, when a disease or condition becomes clinically manifest.

ITA-4.4.4 vyañjakahetuḥ व्यञ्जकहेतुः
Aggravating cause of disease
An etiological factor that sustains, aggravates and stimulates progression of a disease or condition.

ITA-1.8.2.26 vyatirekavyāptiḥ व्यतिरे कव्याप्तिः
Negative invariable concomitance
A condition pertaining to the logical conditions of inference in which minor terms do not exist in all loci with major terms.

ITA-9.6.68 vyadhana karma व्यधनकर्म
Puncture
The procedure of puncturing a body part.

ITA-9.6.138 vyadhanavisrāvaṇakarma व्यधनविस्रावणकर्म
Drainage by puncturing
Therapeutic drainage of a wound by puncture.

ITA-5.19.3 vyapetāhikkā/ yamalāhikkā व्यपेताहिक्का/यमलाहिक्का
Dual or successive hiccups
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: hiccups increasing after food digestion; excessive talking/irrelevant speech/incoherent speech; vomiting; diarrhoea; thirst; senselessness/unconsciousness; yawning; eyes bathed or dimmed with tears; dryness of mouth; body bent/flexed; abdominal distension; hiccups originating from jatru; suppression of breath/death; hiccups in two bouts; shaking of the head and neck.

ITA-4.4.25 vyabhicārihetuḥ व्यभिचारिहेतुः
Mild yet potential causative factor
A nondominant causative factor: it cannot independently give rise to a disease or condition but may contribute to it when the apposite situation arises in the body.

ITA-1.7.27 vyavasāyaḥ व्यवसायः
Decision
Arriving at a clear and unambiguous decision.

ITA-5.76.149 vyavāya vyāyāma pānaklāntānāṃ nasya vyāpadaḥ व्यवाय व्यायाम पानक्लान्तानां नस्य व्यापदः
Condition due to inhalation therapy administered to person fatigued by excessive indulgence in sexual activities; exercise or alcohol
A condition characterized by pain in head; pain in shoulders; pain in eyes; pain in chest.

ITA-5.75.23 vyavāya-vaiṣamyam/ maithunāpacāram व्यवाय-वैषम्यम्/ मैथुनापचारम्
Disorders due to faulty sexual practices

ITA-5.17.5 vyavāyajanyarājayakṣmā व्यवायजन्यराजयक्ष्मा
Consumption due to excessive copulation
A disorder characterized by pallor; signs of depletion of semen; depletion of earlier dhātu.

ITA-5.75.24 vyavāyamithyāyogaḥ/ mithyāvyavāyam व्यवायमिथ्यायोगः/ मिथ्याव्यवायम्
Disorder due to deviated sexual activity

ITA-5.75.25 vyavāyātiyogaḥ व्यवायातियोगः
Disorder due to excessive sexual activity

ITA-6.2.6.39 vyavāyī व्यवायी
Substance spreading all over the body before being digested
Example: intoxication with Cannabis sativa L. and Papaver somniferum L.

ITA-1.6.40 vyākhyā व्याख्या
Explanation, commentary
An exegetical commentary on, or explanation of, Ayurvedic texts.

ITA-1.6.31 vyākhyānam व्याख्यानम्
Lucid explanation
A statement which develops a subject matter in detail.

ITA-2.2.27 balam, vyādhikṣamatvam बलम्, व्याधिक्षमत्वम्
Immunity, strength, physical endurance
This is classified into three types: innate strength, acquired strength and seasonal strength

ITA-4.8.25 vyādhikṣamatvam व्याधिक्षमत्वम्
Inherent capacity of the body to resist diseases
The inherent resisting power of the body, which strives to arrest the occurrence, progress and re-occurrence of diseases.

ITA-10.3.9 vyādhikṣamatva व्याधिक्षमत्व
Immunity

ITA-4.8.26 vyādhibalavirodhitatvam व्याधिबलविरोधितत्वम्
Inherent capacity of the body to resist diseases
A natural, nonspecific type of immunity which defends the body whenever any disease occurs for the first time.

ITA-4.2.3 vyādhibhedaḥ व्याधिभेदः
Types of disease
The categorization of diseases based on various established criteria.

ITA-4.1.1 vyādhiviniścayaḥ, rogaviniścayaḥ व्याधिविनिश्चयः, रोगविनिश्चयः
Diagnosis
Arrived at through careful consideration of information and the application of knowledge. Information is provided by the patient’s narrative, the exploration of signs and symptoms and the results of patient examination. The knowledge derived from the learning and expertise of the physician is applied to this information to arrive at a diagnosis

ITA-4.5.9 vyādhiviparītaḥ व्याधिविपरीतः
Antagonistic to disease
The judicious use of medicines, regimens and dietetics that are antagonistic to the nature of the disease or condition itself.

ITA-9.1.58 vyādhiviparītacikitsā व्याधिविपरीतचिकित्सा
Treatment antagonistic to disease
One of the threefold classifications of treatment antagonistic to the disease.

ITA-4.5.13 vyādhiviparītārthakārī व्याधिविपरीतार्थकारी
Treatment with interventions usually considered to be disease-aggravating factors
The judicious use of medicines, regimens and dietetics that are known to aggravate the signs and symptoms of the disease or condition temporarily but can provide relief from the disease itself.

ITA-4.2.2 vyādhisaṅkaraḥ व्याधिसङ्करः
Comorbidity
A disease that gives rise to another disease while continuing to exist; it may also signify two or more diseases which coexist owing to a similarity of etiology or pathogenic mechanism.

ITA-4.8.29 vyādhisaṅkaraḥ व्याधिसङ्कर
Comorbidity
The presence or co-existence of more than one disease or condition at a given time.

ITA-9.1.4 vyādhiharam व्याधिहरम्
Disease elimination
Cure of disease. Synonym of treatment.

ITA-4.4.20 vyādhihetuḥ व्याधिहेतुः
Disease-specific causes
Factors that give rise to a disease or condition irrespective of the dosha involved.

ITA-4.8.27 vyādhyudpādapratibandhakatvam व्याध्युद्पादप्रतिबन्धकत्वम्
Inherent capacity of the body to resist diseases
The defence mechanism of the body which intervenes to resist the occurrence or re-occurrence of diseases.

ITA-2.1.1.4 vyānaḥ व्यानः
Circulating vata
Subtype of vata seated in the cardiac region (hrdaya), which circulates or diffuses through the body. It performs the function of circulating of fluids through heart to all parts of the body, as well as transporting various materials from one body part to another.

ITA-5.2.1.5 vyānavātakopaḥ व्यानवातकोपः
Aggravation of circulating vata
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: a decrease in virility/semen; decrease or lack of enthusiasm/energy; diminution of physical strength; oedema; excitement; fever; quadriplegia; pricking type of pain; horripilation; numbness of body parts; skin disease; spreading cellulitis or erysipelas; diseases affecting whole body.

ITA-4.5.25 vyāpad व्यापद्
Adverse event
A harmful or prejudicial event occurring during a therapeutic intervention.

ITA-10.3.5 vyāpannaṛtu, ṛtuviparyayaḥ व्यापन्नऋतु, ऋतुविपर्ययः
Abnormal seasonal pattern

ITA-4.2.27 vyāpannartukṛtarogaḥ व्यापन्नर्तुकृतरोगः
Diseases resulting from untimely climatic changes or sudden variations
Diseases and conditions that manifest in the body due to unexpected changes in climate.

ITA-1.8.2.25 vyāptiḥ व्याप्तिः
Invariable concomitance
A condition pertaining to the logical conditions of inference in which minor terms uniformly exist in the same loci as major terms.

ITA-7.1.4.28 vyāmaḥ व्यामः
Distance between tips of middle fingers of outstretched upper limbs
Measure of length equal to the distance between the tip of the middle fingers of both outstretched upper limbs: 72 inches or 182.88 cm.

ITA-9.1.51 vyāyāmaḥ व्यायामः
Therapeutic exercise
The process of making the person take exercise as a therapeutic measure.

ITA-9.2.58 vyāyāmaḥ व्यायामः
Sweating induced by exercise
A type of sudation therapy in which diaphoresis is achieved by doing exercise.

ITA-5.75.26 vyāyāma-vaiṣamyam व्यायाम-वैषम्यम्
Disorders due to improper exercise

ITA-5.17.8 vyāyāmajanyarājayakṣmā व्यायामजन्यराजयक्ष्मा
Consumption due to overexercise
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: pain in chest; haematemesis; typical type of excessive cough; haematuria; stiffness of sides of chest; stiffness of back; stiffness of lumbar region/lower back; clinical features of traumatic chest/pulmonary trauma without injury.

ITA-5.75.27 ativyāyāmaḥ/ vyāyāmatiyogaḥ अतिव्यायामः/ व्यायामतियोगः
Disorder due to excessive physical exercise
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: exhaustion/fatigue; exhaustion without exertion; consumption/tuberculosis; thirst; bleeding disorder; forms of dyspnoea; cough; fever; vomiting.

ITA-9.5.50 vyāyojimaḥ व्यायोजिमः
Lobuloplasty type 8
A type of lobuloplasty indicated when one flap of the divided earlobe is thick and the other one thin or when one is regular and the other irregular.

ITA-4.2.24 vyālakṛtarogaḥ व्यालकृतरोगः
Diseases caused by wild animals
Diseases and conditions caused by physical attack and bites from both tame and wild animals; it includes injuries caused by nails, horns, bites, snake poison and bee stings.
